summary: Final step at the run boundary (~84s of budget left), completing the one premise left open in the prior feedback. Submission is a feedback-only research product (no map version) that now cites the snapshot/protocol version bounds: installSnapshot rejects a request whose SnapshotVersion falls outside the supported range before doing anything else (raft.go 1826-1830) and restoreUserSnapshot applies the same shape of check (raft.go 1109), while the captured constants give SnapshotVersionMax = 1 and ProtocolVersionMax = 3 (config.go 105, 134, with the minima declared alongside). So the installSnapshot harness's SnapshotVersion 1 is the maximum supported value rather than merely an empirically accepted one, which explains why the trusted execution passed the gate and returned Success true; the minima were declared alongside but are not separately quoted. Remaining items are unchanged and now exclusively execution-or-non-crash-stop work: the composed store-failure-plus-compaction history argued by reading but not executed as one witness, the unexercised small-TrailingLogs non-monotonic install shape, the malformed-entry panic lead (DecodeConfiguration and prepareLog's default, with no recover anywhere) having no witness and reachability outside the crash-stop fault model, and the transport reading that described behaviour without evaluating it for defects. Run state is unchanged: map v4, three confirmed in-scope violations (truncation-failure watermark, installSnapshot stale watermark, snapshot-trigger underflow), one reviewed bounded no-violation (configuration rollback), no pending work, no open review issues. Preflight validation returns valid with no diagnostics.
